queries.tables_reloptions: SELECT coalesce(c.reloptions::text,'<null>') FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='information_schema' AND c.relname='tables'
queries.system_rules: SET search_path = pg_catalog; SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name', n.nspname||'.'||c.relname||'.'||r.rulename, 'ev_type', r.ev_type, 'ev_enabled', r.ev_enabled, 'is_instead', r.is_instead, 'definition', pg_get_ruledef(r.oid, true)) ORDER BY n.nspname, c.relname, r.rulename), '[]'::jsonb)::text FROM pg_rewrite r JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=r.ev_class JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname IN ('pg_catalog','information_schema')
queries.qa_sys_rule_present: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_rewrite r JOIN pg_class c ON c.oid=r.ev_class JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid=c.relnamespace WHERE n.nspname='information_schema' AND c.relname='tables' AND r.rulename='qa_sys_rule'
queries.target_database_tablespace: SELECT t.spcname FROM pg_database d JOIN pg_tablespace t ON t.oid=d.dattablespace WHERE d.datname=current_database()
queries.raw_reltablespace_nonzero_count: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_class WHERE reltablespace<>0
queries.filtered_custom_reltablespace_count: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_class c JOIN pg_tablespace t ON t.oid=c.reltablespace WHERE t.spcname NOT IN ('pg_default','pg_global')
queries.unrelated_unused_tablespace_present: SELECT count(*) FROM pg_tablespace WHERE spcname='qa_unused_ts'
queries.migrations_ordered: SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',id,'migration',migration,'batch',batch) ORDER BY id), '[]'::jsonb)::text FROM public.migrations
queries.roles_state: SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('rolname',rolname,'rolsuper',rolsuper,'rolinherit',rolinherit,'rolcreaterole',rolcreaterole,'rolcreatedb',rolcreatedb,'rolcanlogin',rolcanlogin,'rolreplication',rolreplication,'rolbypassrls',rolbypassrls,'rolconnlimit',rolconnlimit,'has_password',rolpassword IS NOT NULL,'is_scram',coalesce(rolpassword LIKE 'SCRAM-SHA-256$%',false)) ORDER BY rolname), '[]'::jsonb)::text FROM pg_authid WHERE rolname LIKE 'kirion_g1b_%' OR rolname LIKE 'n03_%' OR rolname IN ('legacy_owner','legacy_runtime')
queries.memberships_state: SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',r.rolname,'member',m.rolname,'grantor',pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor),'admin_option',a.admin_option,'inherit_option',a.inherit_option,'set_option',a.set_option) ORDER BY r.rolname, m.rolname, pg_get_userbyid(a.grantor)), '[]'::jsonb)::text FROM pg_auth_members a JOIN pg_roles r ON r.oid=a.roleid JOIN pg_roles m ON m.oid=a.member WHERE r.rolname LIKE 'kirion_g1b_%' OR m.rolname LIKE 'kirion_g1b_%' OR r.rolname LIKE 'n03_%' OR m.rolname LIKE 'n03_%' OR r.rolname IN ('legacy_owner','legacy_runtime') OR m.rolname IN ('legacy_owner','legacy_runtime')
queries.effective_authority: SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('role',r.rolname,'db_connect',has_database_privilege(r.oid,current_database(),'CONNECT'),'db_create',has_database_privilege(r.oid,current_database(),'CREATE'),'db_temp',has_database_privilege(r.oid,current_database(),'TEMPORARY'),'pub_usage',has_schema_privilege(r.oid,'public','USAGE'),'pub_create',has_schema_privilege(r.oid,'public','CREATE')) ORDER BY r.rolname), '[]'::jsonb)::text FROM pg_roles r WHERE r.rolname LIKE 'kirion_g1b_%' OR r.rolname LIKE 'n03_%' OR r.rolname IN ('legacy_owner','legacy_runtime')
queries.registry_rows: SELECT coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(i) ORDER BY singleton), '[]'::jsonb)::text FROM deployment_control.installations i
queries.admin_tables_present: SELECT jsonb_build_object('users', to_regclass('public.users') IS NOT NULL, 'employees', to_regclass('public.employees') IS NOT NULL, 'departments', to_regclass('public.departments') IS NOT NULL)::text
queries.unrelated_service: SELECT row_to_json(d) FROM pg_database d WHERE datname='unrelated_service'; SELECT row_to_json(r) FROM pg_roles r WHERE rolname IN ('legacy_owner','legacy_runtime') ORDER BY rolname; SELECT relacl::text,relowner::regrole FROM pg_class WHERE relname='unrelated_marker';
